question.text: A power transmission line feeds input power at <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>3</mn><mo> </mo><mi>kV</mi></math> to a step down transformer with its primary winding having <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>3000</mn><mo> </mo><mtext>turns</mtext></math>. The output power is delivered at <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>230</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">V</mi></math> by the transformer. The current in the primary of the transformer is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>5</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi></math> and its efficiency is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>90</mn><mo>%</mo></math>. The winding of transformer is made of copper. The output current of transformer is ____<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi></math>.
